en: The ₹1 (or intro) charge is often the first cycle offer; from the next cycle your plan amount applies (₹301 / ₹501 / ₹701 or as shown at booking). To stop future debits, cancel the UPI mandate in your payment app.
hi: Pehle cycle par intro/₹1 ho sakta hai; uske baad plan amount (₹301/₹501/₹701 ya jo booking par tha) lagta hai. Mandate cancel karke aage ki katauti rok sakte hain.
